stops.title: Your overview
stops.caption: Your branch, and what it needs today.
stops.speech: Your overview opens on your branch: how many are in the congregation, and what is waiting for you to deal with today.

stops.title: Your branch
stops.caption: Everything inside the one you lead.
stops.speech: My Branch is the whole of the one you lead. Its members, its groups, its services, and the people who have just joined.

stops.title: The directory
stops.caption: Everybody, with their status on the row.
stops.speech: The directory lists everybody in your branch. The row tells you whether they are a visitor, a regular, or have completed the membership class.

stops.title: Follow-ups
stops.caption: Three queues, on a short clock.
stops.speech: Follow-ups has three queues: first-timers nobody has contacted, people in no group, and anybody whose contact is overdue.

stops.title: Concerns
stops.caption: Welfare and safeguarding, kept apart.
stops.speech: Concerns is where welfare and safeguarding sit. They are two separate inboxes on purpose, read by deliberately different people.

stops.title: Your fellowship
stops.caption: The group you lead, and its register.
stops.speech: For the fellowship you lead you can take the register, log a follow-up, and see who has stopped coming.

stops.title: Your department
stops.caption: Roster, rota and recruitment.
stops.speech: For your department you manage the roster, publish the rota, and work through the people applying to join.

stops.title: The souls pipeline
stops.caption: From first contact to a department.
stops.speech: The souls pipeline tracks somebody reached through evangelism, from first contact through to joining a department.

stops.title: Reports
stops.caption: Your branch, in numbers.
stops.speech: Reports turns your branch into numbers: attendance trends, who is missing, and how the groups are growing.
